g.text: OST /auth/rotate Issue a new API key
DELETE /jobs/{id} Cancel a running query, or discard a
GET /sessions List every session on the box
DELETE /sessions/{name} Forget a session and its history
GET /sessions/{name}/artifacts What this session may hand back
POST /sessions/{name}/command Run a declared slash command
POST /sessions/{name}/query Send a prompt and get the answer
PUT /sessions/{name}/skills/{skill} Add a skill to one session
PUT /sessions/{name}/system-prompt Set the session's appended system prompt
